payload.claim: The "Notes for the agent" section claims "The one queued spec, SA-0381, touches saffron/follow_up.py and tests/test_follow_up.py" to justify adding no depends_on entry, but at this snapshot SA-0381 already sits under .saffron/specs/done/ and is not queued at all; the actually-queued specs are SA-0384 and SA-0386 (plus SA-0385 itself), neither of which overlaps saffron/batch.py or tests/test_batch.py. The stated justification is factually wrong about the repository's current state even though the conclusion (no depends_on needed) still happens to hold.
